bbcredbutton.uk.title: Best of Radio 2 in the Park 2026
bbcredbutton.uk.description: Relive the biggest and best moments from an unforgettable weekend as Radio 2 in the Park made its Scottish debut in spectacular Stirling. Expect huge performances from the likes of Deacon Blue, Appleton, Blue, Cast, James Blunt, Level 42, Texas, Lulu, Jack Savoretti, ABC, The Script, Emeli Sandé and this year's headliners, the 'queen of funk' Chaka Khan and local legends Simple Minds, as we celebrate a spectacular two days of incredible live music.

bbctwoengland.uk.title: Emergency 24/7
bbctwoengland.uk.description: S1 E6 Mystery Infection Twenty-six-year-old Kye is rushed into Resus suffering alcohol withdrawal seizures, but ED consultant Hazel is also concerned about an abscess on his arm that has failed to respond to treatment. After a motorbike crash, older couple Ken and Carol are brought into the emergency department, with Ken in extreme pain. Trauma team leader Jules treats 88-year-old Lady Carole, who has fractured her leg.

bbctwoengland.uk.title: Wham! 10 Days in China
bbctwoengland.uk.description: In 1985, Wham! were the first Western pop group to perform in communist China, with George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley's two concerts in Beijing and Guangzhou introducing the genre to Chinese audiences and marked a turning point for the band. Drawing on meticulously restored, newly digitised and never-before-seen archive footage, alongside interviews with those who experienced the tour first-hand, this documentary revisits this historic moment through the eyes of the band, their team and Chinese audiences encountering Western pop culture for the first time.

bbctwoengland.uk.title: Saving Lives at Sea
bbctwoengland.uk.description: S11 E3 Family SOS The Newbiggin crew race to the rescue of three children who have been swept out to sea on a small inflatable dinghy. In Selsey, a mayday comes in from a vessel taking on water in the English Channel and on the Dorset coast, the Lyme Regis crew respond to reports of a couple cut off by a landslide on a notorious stretch of coast.

skydrama.uk.description: Escaping postwar Europe, a visionary architect comes to America to rebuild his life, his career, and his marriage. On his own in a strange new country, he settles in Pennsylvania, where a wealthy and prominent industrialist recognises his talent. (Drama) - 2024

skydrama.uk.title: Quartet (2012)
skydrama.uk.description: A long-smouldering flame is rekindled when a once-popular opera star reunites with her ex-husband and fellow performers at a retirement home for musicians. (Comedy drama) - 2012

skydrama.uk.title: The Pursuit of Happiness (1971)
skydrama.uk.description: William Popper (Michael Sarrazin) is a wealthy, shiftless college student at Columbia who, one night in a rainstorm, accidentally kills a jaywalker with his car. Sentenced to a year in prison for manslaughter, William begins serving his term, but before it's finished he decides to break out. With the help of his faithful and politically radical girlfriend, Jane (Barbara Hershey), he skips town and escapes to Canada, where the two are obliged to live like fugitives. (Drama) - 1971

skygreats.uk.title: Jerry Maguire (1996)
skygreats.uk.description: A sports agent who makes the mistake of saying what he believes, finds himself sacked and abandoned by all his clients apart from small time footballer Rod Tidwell. Maguire's personal life starts to fall apart as he's torn between love and money in Cameron Crowe's metaphor on Americans' need for success and money. (Drama / Romantic comedy) - 1996

skygreats.uk.title: Cool Hand Luke (1967)
skygreats.uk.description: A gutsy prisoner earns the admiration of inmates and the wrath of guards by constant defiance and bids for freedom. (Drama) - 1967

skygreats.uk.title: Sky Cinema Preview - Sept 2026

skythriller.uk.title: A Clockwork Orange (1971)
skythriller.uk.description: In an England of the future, Alex de Large is the leader of a gang of droogs whose pastime is violence, sex and murder, but whose eventual punishment is almost as extreme and violent as his crimes. Betrayed by the other members of his gang, he is arrested and offered an experimental treatment in order to shorten his sentence. (Black comedy / Drama / Science fiction) - 1971

skythriller.uk.title: One Last Deal (2026)
skythriller.uk.description: A veteran sports agent races to secure a final lucrative contract for his star client, as both their careers and lives hang in the balance. Starring Danny Dyer. (Thriller) - 2026

skythriller.uk.title: Scarface (1983)

CANAL+.Sport.pl.title: Piłka nożna: PKO BP Ekstraklasa - mecz: Wisła Kraków - Śląsk Wrocław
CANAL+.Sport.pl.description: Poprzednie spotkanie obu ekip wygenerowało mnóstwo emocji. Niestety, tylko tych negatywnych, a mecz dwóch walczących wówczas o awans do Ekstraklasy zespołów ostatecznie nie doszedł do skutku. Władze Śląska Wrocław uniemożliwiły wejście na stadion kibicom Wisły Kraków, a zarządzający Białą Gwiazdą Jarosław Królewski zadecydował, że w tej sytuacji jego piłkarze nie wyjdą na boisko. Tym razem o odwołaniu meczu nie może być mowy. Przekonamy się, jak Krakowianie przywitają gości po tamtych wydarzeniach.
